newsitem.title: CHINA: China tea export rises from southwestern province.
newsitem.headline: China tea export rises from southwestern province.

text.p: Tea exports from China's southwestern Yunnan province rose a year-on-year 44 percent to 11,408 tonnes in 1996, an official of the Yunnan Tea Import and Export Co said on Monday.
The province earned $20.84 million from tea exports, up 29.8 percent from the previous year, the official said.

However, declining quality troubled the provincial tea industry. The rate of substandard black tea produce rose by 18 percent, while the rate for Chiense Pu'er tea rose 2.9 percent compared with 1995, an official from the Yunnan Commodity Inspection Bureau said without giving comparative figures.
Fierce price competition among exporters and poor quality had helped to send prices into a slump last year.
China's output of tea in 1996 has been estimated at 510,000 tonnes.
